1.mascotDialogue: One edge, two entries in the adjacency matrix! Forget the second, and you have quietly built half a directed graph instead.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3, they are not optional extras of each other — they are the same conceptual edge, and must be added together, as one pair, every single time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time — just a plain line, because the connection, she is mutual by nature.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual shows a single arrowhead where an undirected graph should never have one at all — this mismatch, tesoro, is the bug, and rather hard to miss.
